sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.coverage: SEC filers; standard US GAAP facts in this adapter. IFRS and company-specific extensions are explicit coverage gaps.
sources.auth: No API key; identifying server-side SEC_USER_AGENT required.
sources.refresh: As filings disseminate; bulk archives nightly. Application caches 30 minutes to 6 hours.
sources.rateLimit: SEC maximum 10 requests/second across machines; app uses durable 2/second budget.
sources.license: Public SEC APIs; comply with fair access. Underlying issuer material may contain third-party rights.
sources.fallback: Last verified observation with its original timestamp, then official source link.
sources.validation: Company identity, same-period calculations, filing metadata, failure retention and rate budgets tested locally; production access must be checked from deployed Worker.
